(나) Taxi distance and fare: 1 km 3500 won, 2 km 4000 won, 4 km 5000 won (3000 won base fare plus 500 won per km)
(다) Walking time and distance: 10 minutes 800 m, 20 minutes 1600 m, 30 minutes 2400 m (same walking speed, no rest)
